recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-8141; future work should not reintroduce or edit retired DAF profile pages unless explicitly maintaining historical publication artifacts outside the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-8141 asked to remove invalid entries from the constraints and term binding tables for the 2015May/DSTU1 DAF Smoking Status Observation profile because the profile disallowed Observation.referenceRange while generated tables still included child entries for that element. Jira status is Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification and the resolution note says the issue was fixed as a result of other work.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-8141 implementation commit was found. Historical source before the old DAF guide deletion shows only a single Observation.referenceRange 0..0 row in the DAF Smoking Status spreadsheet and no referenceRange child rows; later DAF2 Smoking Status source/rendered history checked from commits contains no referenceRange rows. This supports the Jira note that the problem was resolved through other profile-generation or DAF cleanup work rather than a dedicated FHIR-8141 commit.
additional_context: The current build keeps Observation active but has no active Data Access Framework IG or DAF Smoking Status profile. source/igs.xml contains only a commented DAF IG entry, source/fhir.ini has no active DAF profile entry, and current file searches found no DAF Smoking Status profile source. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant discussion or minutes that would change this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The requested cleanup applies to a retired historical DAF generated table, not to current build-scope core source, and the historical evidence indicates the invalid referenceRange child rows were already removed.
